title: PrismCrawl Apple App Store API input
description: Search the Apple App Store, get app details, and collect app reviews through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Choose what to fetch. Search uses Search query; app details and reviews use App ID.

query.title: Search query
query.description: For search: text to search the App Store for.

category.title: Platform
category.description: For search: which App Store catalog to search.

id.title: App ID
id.description: For app details and reviews: the numeric App Store ID, as returned by search or shown in the app's URL (for example 284882215).

sort_by.title: Review order
sort_by.description: For reviews: the order to return them in.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (search and reviews only). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

limit.title: Items per page
limit.description: Maximum apps or reviews per page (1–100). Apple may return fewer.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country or storefront code, such as us or gb.

language.title: Language
language.description: For search and app details: a language code such as en. Search supports en and ja. Not used for reviews.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
